title: A $j$-translation with Kripke forcing relation
summary: In this paper, we introduce a translation that combines the $j$-translation with Kripke forcing in the internal logic of an elementary topos. First, we show that our translation is sound for intuitionistic first-order logic and Heyting arithmetic. Furthermore, its interpretation in the effective topos provides an extension of the sheaf model of realizability introduced by de Jongh and Goodman.
